messages.subject: Re: MSstats
parts:
Dear Tatjana,

Thank you for sharing this error message from global standards. 
This command line itself seems right. So, I need to look at more details. If you don't mind, could you share two things with me?
   1. msstats.log file: probably msstats.log file is generated if you run 'dataProcess' under the working directory. If you are not sure where is the working directory, please use 'getwd()'. Then it will show the working directory. If you can't find the msstats.log, could you run 'sessionInfo()' and then send me the output?
   2. subset of data : In order to look at more details, It would be great if I can work the subset of your data. I need the data for proteins or peptides named "P02765", "O75882" and extra one or two proteins or peptides. You can use the below codes to get subset of data.

## if you want to global standard proteins
subset<-raw[which(raw$ProteinName %in% c( "P02765", "O75882", protein1, protein2)),]
save(subset, file="subset.RData")

## if you want to global standard peptides
subset<-raw[which(raw$PeptideSequence %in% c( "P02765", "O75882",peptide1, peptide2)),]
save(subset, file="subset.RData")

I'm sorry for your inconvenience. As soon as I got these information, I will try to find the solution.
Thank you,

Meena
